material.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Apr 9 to Jul 29 (+47%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−8.9% to −15%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the Oct 14 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−23%); a close over the wave-1 high (+14%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.
